# Input limit parser

parse_limit accepts strings of one to three ASCII decimal digits whose integer value is 1 through 255 inclusive. Leading zeroes are allowed within the three-character limit. It returns that integer. Every other input must raise ValueError. This guards a user-supplied resource limit. No product changes are authorized.
